::: {.remark .notes}

The proof needs measure theory beyond these notes:
the sets $A_1 \times \cdots \times A_n$ form a
[$\pi$-system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pi-system),
and two probability measures that agree on a $\pi$-system
agree on the $\sigma$-algebra it generates
[@billingsley1995probability].

:::
